label: 1. Is this the Commander of the Counters?

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Is this the Commander of the Counters?
Yeah.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Good to finally meet you.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I managed to get your contact info and decided to reach out.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I've always admired the Counters for protecting the Ark.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You're all incredibly strong.
Come on, we're not that amazing.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: No, it's true.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You face countless Raptures every day without fear

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: and fight them every waking moment.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Credit should be given where it's due.
Same goes for the Ark Rangers.
You were amazing in that last battle.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I suppose that's true.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: The Ark Rangers still can't compare to the Counters,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: but we're doing everything we can to protect the Ark.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: It may not be much, but we're giving it our all.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I only wish we could do more.
That's really impressive.
No wonder the Ark Rangers are so popular.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: You flatter us.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: There's probably no one in the Ark who doesn't know who you are.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I've also drawn a lot of strength from watching the Counters myself.
Really?
That's an honor.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: The Ark Rangers want to inspire hope in people too.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: That's why I train every single day.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I'm looking forward to working with you.
Same here.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: If I ever run into trouble during training, would it be all right if I contacted you?
Sure, feel free to.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: I'll be in touch again.
